entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: sum/avg-mixed-or subquery input is %T with %s sample kind
entries.rationale: mixedRel is produced by lowerSumOrAvgOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp and its combineMixedAggregateBranches return, a VectorSetOp with Mixed set. That node's RowType has SampleKindMixed, so a different kind is an internal postcondition failure rather than a query-level rejection.
